tools.name: effectconnect_list_channels
tools.description: List the channels (marketplaces and webshops) linked to the EffectConnect API key. Use the channel identifier in other tools. Needs scope channels:read. GET /v3/channels.

tools.name: effectconnect_get_channel
tools.description: Get one channel by its identifier. Needs scope channels:read. GET /v3/channel/{identifier}.

tools.name: effectconnect_list_product_selections
tools.description: List the product selections (named groups of products that a channel can sell) with pagination. Needs scope productSelections:read. GET /v3/product-selections.

tools.name: effectconnect_get_product_selection
tools.description: Get one product selection by its numeric identifier. Needs scope productSelections:read. GET /v3/product-selection/{identifier}.

tools.name: effectconnect_list_product_selection_products
tools.description: List the products in one product selection, with pagination. Needs scope productSelections:read. GET /v3/product-selection/{identifier}/products.

tools.name: effectconnect_list_products
tools.description: List all products of the API key, page by page. Pass the nextPageToken from a reply to get the next page. Needs scope products:read. GET /v3/products.

tools.name: effectconnect_search_products
tools.description: Find products by product selection, by parent API identifier, or by product identifiers (API identifier, SKU, EAN or external identifier). Needs scope products:read. POST /v3/products/search.

tools.name: effectconnect_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by an identifier of the given type (API identifier, SKU, EAN or external identifier). Needs scope products:read. GET /v3/product/{identifierType}/{identifier}.

tools.name: effectconnect_search_orders
tools.description: Find orders by order date, last update, status, tag or channel. Leave the filters empty to list all orders page by page. Needs scope orders:read. POST /v3/orders/search.

tools.name: effectconnect_read_orders
tools.description: Get up to 100 orders by their identifiers (EffectConnect ID or number, channel identifier or number, connection identifier or number, or invoice). Needs scope orders:read. POST /v3/orders/read.

tools.name: effectconnect_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by an identifier of the given type. Pass channel_identifier when the identifier is not unique. Needs scope orders:read. GET /v3/order/{identifierType}/{identifier}.

tools.name: effectconnect_list_processes
tools.description: List asynchronous processes (catalog and order reports) and their status. Filter by type or status. Processes are kept for 48 hours. GET /v3/processes.

tools.name: effectconnect_get_process
tools.description: Get the status of one asynchronous process by its identifier (QUEUED, PROCESSING, FINISHED or CRITICAL_ERROR). Processes are kept for 48 hours. GET /v3/process/{identifier}.

tools.name: effectconnect_get_process_report
tools.description: Get the report of one finished asynchronous process. A report exists only when the status is FINISHED, and it is removed after 48 hours. GET /v3/process/{identifier}/report.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: effectconnect_search_products, effectconnect_search_orders, effectconnect_read_orders · Private data: effectconnect_list_channels, effectconnect_list_products · Public sink: effectconnect_search_products, effectconnect_search_orders, effectconnect_read_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: effectconnect_search_products, effectconnect_search_orders, effectconnect_read_orders · Private data: effectconnect_list_channels, effectconnect_list_products · Public sink: effectconnect_search_products, effectconnect_search_orders, effectconnect_read_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
